import json,re,time,random,chess
RE=json.load(open('re.json'))
random.seed(0)
b=chess.Board()
k=0;T=time.time()
from collections import Counter
C=Counter()
while not b.is_game_over():
    if b.turn:
        s=b.fen()
        for i,(p,r) in enumerate(RE):
            t=time.time(); s=re.sub(p,r,s); C[i]+=time.time()-t
        k+=1
    b.push(random.choice(list(b.legal_moves)))
print(k,time.time()-T)
for i,v in C.most_common(8): print(i,RE[i][0],v)
"
